tableDescription: Line-item retail sales transactions for a Chinese superstore, tracking orders, customers, products, shipping, revenue, and profit.

columnDescriptions.row_id: Unique surrogate key identifying each individual order line item.
columnDescriptions.order_id: Business identifier grouping multiple line items under one customer order.
columnDescriptions.order_date: Calendar date when the customer placed the order.
columnDescriptions.ship_date: Calendar date when the order was dispatched for delivery.
columnDescriptions.ship_mode: Shipping speed tier selected for the order, such as standard or express.
columnDescriptions.customer_id: Unique identifier for the purchasing customer.
columnDescriptions.customer_name: Full name of the customer who placed the order.
columnDescriptions.segment: Market segment classifying the customer, such as consumer or small business.
columnDescriptions.city: City of the delivery destination or customer location.
columnDescriptions.province: Province or autonomous region of the delivery destination.
columnDescriptions.country_region: Country or top-level region of the delivery destination.
columnDescriptions.region: Broader geographic sales territory grouping multiple provinces together.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Unique identifier for the sold product SKU.
columnDescriptions.category: Top-level product classification, such as office supplies or furniture.
columnDescriptions.sub_category: Granular product grouping nested within a top-level category.
columnDescriptions.product_name: Full descriptive name of the sold product.
columnDescriptions.sales: Total revenue for this line item after applying the discount.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Number of product units ordered in this line item.
columnDescriptions.discount: Fractional discount rate applied to the line item price.
columnDescriptions.profit: Net profit on this line item after all costs and discounts.
columnDescriptions.postal_code: Postal code of the shipping destination address.
columnDescriptions.source_system: Name of the originating system that provided the raw data.
columnDescriptions.source_file: File path of the source spreadsheet used during data loading.
columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Worksheet name within the source file containing this data.
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Row number in the source file for end-to-end traceability.
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Identifier for the ETL import batch that loaded this record.
columnDescriptions.row_hash: SHA-256 hash of business fields used to detect record changes.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; 1 marks a logically deleted record, 0 is active.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted into the database.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this record.

tableDescription: Maps each sales region to its assigned regional manager, sourced from the Tableau Superstore sample dataset.

columnDescriptions.region: Geographic sales region name, such as Northeast or Central-South.
columnDescriptions.regional_manager: Full name of the manager responsible for the sales region.
columnDescriptions.source_system: Identifier of the upstream system that provided this data.
columnDescriptions.source_file: Full file path of the original data source file.
columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Worksheet name within the source file where data was extracted.
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Row position of this record within the original source file.
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Unique identifier for the ETL import batch run.
columnDescriptions.row_hash: SHA-256 hash of business fields used for change detection.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; 1 indicates logically deleted, 0 indicates active.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted into the database.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this record.

tableDescription: Tracks orders marked as returned from the Tableau Superstore sample dataset, including ETL lineage and audit metadata.

columnDescriptions.id: Surrogate primary key uniquely identifying each return record.
columnDescriptions.order_id: Business key linking this return entry to a specific customer order.
columnDescriptions.returned: Indicates the order was returned; Chinese value '是' means Yes.
columnDescriptions.source_system: Name of the upstream system that supplied the return data.
columnDescriptions.source_file: Full file path of the Excel workbook the record was extracted from.
columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Worksheet tab name within the source workbook containing return rows.
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Row position in the source file where this record originated.
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Identifier grouping all records loaded together in one import run.
columnDescriptions.row_hash: SHA-256 hash of business fields used for deduplication and change detection.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; 1 marks the record logically removed, 0 is active.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted into the database.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this record.

tableDescription: Registry of business customers capturing identity, segmentation, regional assignment, and account lifecycle status.

columnDescriptions.customer_id: Unique numeric identifier for each customer record.
columnDescriptions.customer_name: Official business name of the customer organization.
columnDescriptions.customer_type: Business size classification, such as Enterprise or SMB.
columnDescriptions.customer_level: Tiered value or priority rating assigned to the customer, e.g., A or B.
columnDescriptions.region_id: Foreign key referencing the geographic sales region of the customer.
columnDescriptions.signup_date: Date the customer formally enrolled or was onboarded.
columnDescriptions.is_active: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer account is currently active.
columnDescriptions.created_at: System timestamp recording when this customer row was first inserted.

tableDescription: Monthly aggregated AI-driven sales performance metrics segmented by region, channel, product category, and customer type.

columnDescriptions.data_source: Origin system or dataset identifier for traceability and multi-source management.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent record modification.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted.
columnDescriptions.data_end_date: Inclusive end date of the source data extraction window (YYYYMMDD).
columnDescriptions.data_start_date: Inclusive start date of the source data extraction window (YYYYMMDD).
columnDescriptions.avg_order_amount: Average net revenue value per order within the segment.
columnDescriptions.unit_cost_avg: Average cost incurred per unit sold.
columnDescriptions.profit_rate: Gross profit margin expressed as a ratio of net revenue.
columnDescriptions.avg_discount_rate: Average discount percentage applied to orders.
columnDescriptions.avg_unit_price: Average net selling price per unit sold.
columnDescriptions.stat_month: Calendar month this summary record represents.
columnDescriptions.region_id: Numeric identifier for the geographic sales region.
columnDescriptions.region_name: Human-readable name of the geographic sales region.
columnDescriptions.channel_name: Sales channel through which orders were placed.
columnDescriptions.customer_type: Customer segment classification, e.g., Enterprise, SMB, Individual.
columnDescriptions.order_cnt: Total number of distinct orders in the period.
columnDescriptions.row_cnt: Number of underlying detail rows aggregated into this summary.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Total units sold across all orders.
columnDescriptions.gross_amount: Total revenue before any discounts are applied.
columnDescriptions.net_amount: Total revenue after discounts are applied.
columnDescriptions.cost_amount: Total cost of goods or services sold.
columnDescriptions.profit_amount: Total profit calculated as net revenue minus total cost.

tableDescription: Dimension table defining China's geographic sales regions, their hierarchy levels, and responsible managers.

columnDescriptions.region_id: Unique numeric surrogate key identifying each geographic region.
columnDescriptions.region_name: Chinese name of the sales region, e.g., East China (华东区).
columnDescriptions.region_level: Hierarchy tier of the region, e.g., major region (大区).
columnDescriptions.manager_name: Full name of the person accountable for overseeing the region.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the region record was first added to the system.

tableDescription: Records individual sales transactions with pricing, discounts, costs, and profit across customers, products, regions, and channels.

columnDescriptions.order_id: Unique identifier for each sales order.
columnDescriptions.order_date: Calendar date the order was placed by the customer.
columnDescriptions.customer_id: Foreign key linking the order to the purchasing customer.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Foreign key identifying the specific product purchased.
columnDescriptions.region_id: Foreign key identifying the geographic sales region.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Number of product units included in the order.
columnDescriptions.unit_price: Listed selling price per single product unit before discounts.
columnDescriptions.discount_rate: Decimal discount rate applied to reduce the gross amount.
columnDescriptions.gross_amount: Pre-discount revenue; quantity multiplied by unit price.
columnDescriptions.net_amount: Actual billed revenue after the discount rate is applied.
columnDescriptions.cost_amount: Total cost of goods sold associated with this order.
columnDescriptions.profit_amount: Net amount minus cost; realized gross margin on the order.
columnDescriptions.order_status: Current lifecycle stage, e.g., completed, pending, or cancelled.
columnDescriptions.channel_name: Sales channel through which the order was placed, e.g., Direct, Online, Partner.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when this order record was inserted into the database.

tableDescription: Catalog of sellable products with pricing, categorization, and availability status across software and service offerings.

columnDescriptions.product_id: Unique numeric identifier for each product in the catalog.
columnDescriptions.product_name: Full display name of the product offered for sale.
columnDescriptions.category_name: Top-level grouping of the product, such as software or hardware.
columnDescriptions.subcategory_name: Secondary classification within the category for finer product segmentation.
columnDescriptions.unit_price: Selling price charged to customers per unit.
columnDescriptions.unit_cost: Internal cost to produce or procure one unit.
columnDescriptions.is_active: Boolean flag indicating whether the product is currently available for sale.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp recording when the product was first added to the catalog.

tableDescription: Tableau prep staging table holding periodic financial statement data by entity, account, and performance indicator across reporting periods.

columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent update to the record.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first created in the system.
columnDescriptions.etl_batch_id: Identifier linking the record to its ETL pipeline batch run.
columnDescriptions.stats_date: Specific date the statistical or financial data represents.
columnDescriptions.period_amount: Financial or metric value for the specific reporting period only.
columnDescriptions.stats_yyyymm: Year and month of the statistic in YYYYMM format.
columnDescriptions.stats_year: Calendar year associated with the statistical data.
columnDescriptions.report_period: Label for the reporting period, such as January or Q1.
columnDescriptions.report_period_range: Start and end date range defining the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.entity_code: Short code uniquely identifying the business entity or organizational unit.
columnDescriptions.entity_name: Full descriptive name of the business entity or organizational unit.
columnDescriptions.statement_section: Section of the financial statement the line item belongs to.
columnDescriptions.line_level: Hierarchical depth level of the line item within the statement.
columnDescriptions.line_order: Numeric sort order for displaying line items within a section.
columnDescriptions.line_code: Unique code identifying a specific line item in the statement.
columnDescriptions.account_code: General ledger or chart-of-accounts code for the financial account.
columnDescriptions.account_name: Descriptive name of the financial account tied to the line.
columnDescriptions.indicator_name: Name of the financial or performance metric being tracked.
columnDescriptions.indicator_unit: Unit of measurement for the indicator, such as currency or percentage.
columnDescriptions.ytd_amount: Cumulative year-to-date financial amount from the start of the year.
columnDescriptions.load_time: Timestamp when the record was loaded into this staging table.
columnDescriptions.data_source: Upstream system or origin from which the data was sourced.

tableDescription: Balance sheet fact table storing periodic financial line-item balances by entity, reporting period, and account classification.

columnDescriptions.stats_date: First day of the reporting month; serves as the time dimension key.
columnDescriptions.stats_yyyymm: Year-month identifier for the reporting period in YYYYMM format.
columnDescriptions.stats_year: Calendar year extracted from the reporting date.
columnDescriptions.report_period: Standardized reporting cycle label: Q1, interim, Q3, or annual report.
columnDescriptions.report_period_range: Start-to-end month range covered by the report period.
columnDescriptions.entity_name: Legal name of the reporting company or accounting entity.
columnDescriptions.entity_code: Unique identifier code for the reporting entity.
columnDescriptions.statement_section: Balance sheet section grouping: current assets, liabilities, or equity.
columnDescriptions.line_level: Hierarchy depth of the line item within the balance sheet structure.
columnDescriptions.line_order: Display sequence number controlling the sort order of line items.
columnDescriptions.line_code: Internal configuration code uniquely identifying each balance sheet line item.
columnDescriptions.account_code: ERP source system account code; placeholder when not yet mapped.
columnDescriptions.account_name: Official account name from the chart of accounts.
columnDescriptions.indicator_name: Front-end display label for the financial metric.
columnDescriptions.indicator_unit: Unit of measurement for the indicator value, such as currency.
columnDescriptions.opening_balance: Account balance at the beginning of the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.ending_balance: Account balance at the end of the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.data_source: Origin system or process that supplied the financial data.
columnDescriptions.load_time: Timestamp when the ETL process last loaded or refreshed this record.
columnDescriptions.etl_batch_id: ETL job batch identifier used for reconciliation and troubleshooting.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted into the table.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent update to the record.

tableDescription: Cash flow statement fact table storing periodic line items by entity, report period, and activity section.

columnDescriptions.stats_date: First day of the accounting month representing the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.stats_yyyymm: Year-month identifier for the accounting period in YYYYMM format.
columnDescriptions.stats_year: Fiscal year extracted from the statistics date.
columnDescriptions.report_period: Standardized report type: Q1, interim, Q3, or annual.
columnDescriptions.report_period_range: Start-to-end month span covered by the report, formatted YYYYMM-YYYYMM.
columnDescriptions.entity_name: Legal name of the reporting company or accounting entity.
columnDescriptions.entity_code: Unique numeric identifier for the reporting entity.
columnDescriptions.statement_section: Cash flow activity category: operating, investing, or financing.
columnDescriptions.line_level: Hierarchy depth of the line item within the statement structure.
columnDescriptions.line_order: Numeric sequence controlling display order in financial reports.
columnDescriptions.line_code: Unique configuration code identifying each financial indicator.
columnDescriptions.account_code: ERP source account code; may be empty for some records.
columnDescriptions.account_name: ERP account name serving as a stable unique key for mapping.
columnDescriptions.indicator_name: Front-end display label for the cash flow line item.
columnDescriptions.indicator_unit: Unit of measurement, typically currency (元) or percentage.
columnDescriptions.ytd_amount: Cumulative year-to-date cash flow amount for the report period.
columnDescriptions.period_amount: Cash flow amount for the current single period only.
columnDescriptions.data_source: Origin system or report supplying the financial data.
columnDescriptions.load_time: Timestamp when the ETL process last loaded this record.
columnDescriptions.etl_batch_id: ETL job batch identifier used for reconciliation and troubleshooting.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted into the table.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

tableDescription: Financial profit and loss fact table storing periodic P&L indicators with YTD and current period amounts by entity and reporting period.

columnDescriptions.stats_date: First day of the accounting month representing the statistical period.
columnDescriptions.stats_yyyymm: Year-month identifier of the statistical period in YYYYMM format.
columnDescriptions.stats_year: Fiscal year extracted from the statistical date.
columnDescriptions.report_period: Standardized reporting cycle label: quarterly, interim, or annual report.
columnDescriptions.report_period_range: Start-to-end month range covered by the report period, e.g., 202501-202509.
columnDescriptions.entity_name: Full legal name of the accounting entity being reported.
columnDescriptions.entity_code: Unique identifier code for the accounting entity.
columnDescriptions.statement_section: High-level P&L category grouping, e.g., revenue, cost, or investment income.
columnDescriptions.line_level: Hierarchy depth of the P&L line item within the report structure.
columnDescriptions.line_order: Display sequence number for ordering line items in reports.
columnDescriptions.line_code: Internal configuration code uniquely identifying each P&L indicator.
columnDescriptions.account_code: ERP source account code; may be empty in current implementation.
columnDescriptions.account_name: ERP account name serving as a unique key; generally stable over time.
columnDescriptions.indicator_name: Front-end display label for the P&L line item.
columnDescriptions.indicator_unit: Measurement unit for the indicator, typically currency or percentage.
columnDescriptions.ytd_amount: Year-to-date cumulative financial amount for the indicator.
columnDescriptions.period_amount: Current reporting period financial amount for the indicator.
columnDescriptions.data_source: Origin system or report from which the data was sourced.
columnDescriptions.load_time: Timestamp when the ETL process last loaded or updated the record.
columnDescriptions.etl_batch_id: ETL batch identifier used for data reconciliation and troubleshooting.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted into the table.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

tableDescription: Tracks hospital visit accrual revenue by department, doctor, visit type, and billing category for financial reporting.

columnDescriptions.date: Date of the hospital visit or billing accrual record.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Hospital branch or campus where the visit occurred.
columnDescriptions.visit_department: Clinical department where the patient received medical services.
columnDescriptions.finance_department: Accounting department responsible for billing and revenue attribution.
columnDescriptions.visit_type: Categorizes the encounter as outpatient or inpatient.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Attending physician who provided the medical service.
columnDescriptions.visit_content: Specific medical service, procedure, or clinical reason for the visit.
columnDescriptions.bill_subtype: High-level billing category classifying the type of medical charge.
columnDescriptions.order_subtype: Secondary classification of the medical order or service type.
columnDescriptions.order_item: Specific chargeable service or procedure item billed to the patient.
columnDescriptions.amount: Accrued revenue amount in local currency for the record.

tableDescription: Daily inpatient admission counts aggregated by hospital branch, clinical department, billing department, doctor, and admission type.

columnDescriptions.date: Calendar date on which the inpatient admissions were recorded.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Name of the hospital branch or campus where patients were admitted.
columnDescriptions.visit_department: Clinical department that clinically managed and treated the admitted patients.
columnDescriptions.finance_department: Department credited for billing and financial accounting of the admissions.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Name of the attending physician responsible for the admitted patients.
columnDescriptions.admission_type: Category of inpatient stay, such as day-care, standard, or obstetric admission.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Count of patients admitted under this specific attribute combination.

tableDescription: Daily outpatient visit records across hospital branches, tracking departments, doctors, patient novelty status, and visit volume.

columnDescriptions.date: Calendar date on which the outpatient visits occurred.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Name of the hospital branch or campus where visits took place.
columnDescriptions.visit_department: Clinical department that physically received and treated the patient.
columnDescriptions.finance_department: Department credited for billing and internal financial reporting.
columnDescriptions.visit_content: Specific medical service, procedure, or consultation type delivered.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Name of the attending physician who conducted the visit.
columnDescriptions.is_group_new_customer: Y/N flag: patient visiting the entire hospital group for the first time.
columnDescriptions.is_hospital_new_customer: Y/N flag: patient visiting this specific hospital branch for the first time.
columnDescriptions.is_dept_new_customer: Y/N flag: patient visiting this specific department for the first time.
columnDescriptions.employee_flag: Indicates whether the patient is a hospital employee or general public.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Count of outpatient visits for this date-department-doctor combination.

tableDescription: Individual question-level patient satisfaction survey responses, linking each answer to its clinical visit context and service area.

columnDescriptions.survey_id: Unique identifier grouping all question responses from a single submitted survey.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical department where the patient received care.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Name of the attending physician associated with the patient visit.
columnDescriptions.submit_date: Date the patient submitted the satisfaction survey.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Hospital branch or campus where the patient visit occurred.
columnDescriptions.survey_name: Full title of the satisfaction survey form administered to the patient.
columnDescriptions.question_id: Sequential code distinguishing each question within the survey form.
columnDescriptions.question_text: Verbatim wording of the survey question presented to the patient.
columnDescriptions.question_category: Numeric grouping classifying the question into a survey section or domain.
columnDescriptions.question_type: Staff role or service area the question evaluates, e.g., doctor, ultrasound.
columnDescriptions.answer: Patient's selected or entered response to the survey question.
columnDescriptions.standard_hospital: Normalized hospital name for consistent cross-branch reporting and analysis.

tableDescription: Daily hospital settlement records tracking payment amounts by branch, clinical department, fee category, and payment method.

columnDescriptions.date: Calendar date on which the settlement transaction occurred.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Name of the hospital branch or campus where services were provided.
columnDescriptions.finance_department: Clinical department responsible for generating the charge, e.g., obstetrics or gynecology.
columnDescriptions.fee_type: Category of charge, such as product, stored-value card, package, or bill.
columnDescriptions.payment_method: Method used to settle the payment, e.g., cash, bank card, or remittance.
columnDescriptions.amount: Monetary value of the settlement transaction in local currency.

tableDescription: Patient survey responses capturing wait time experience questions across hospital branches, departments, and doctors.

columnDescriptions.survey_id: Unique identifier for each submitted patient satisfaction survey.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical department or specialty unit where the patient was seen.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Name of the attending physician associated with the survey.
columnDescriptions.submit_date: Date the patient submitted their satisfaction survey.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Hospital branch or campus where the patient visit occurred.
columnDescriptions.survey_name: Full title of the patient satisfaction survey form administered.
columnDescriptions.question_id: Code identifying the specific wait time question within the survey.
columnDescriptions.question_text: Full text of the wait time question presented to the patient.
columnDescriptions.question_category: Numeric category grouping this question belongs to in the survey.
columnDescriptions.question_type: Format or classification type of the survey question.
columnDescriptions.answer: Patient's response indicating whether wait times were acceptable or problematic.
columnDescriptions.standard_hospital: Normalized hospital branch name used for consistent cross-branch reporting.

tableDescription: Monthly patient satisfaction survey metrics aggregated per doctor, department, and hospital branch.

columnDescriptions.submit_date: The specific date on which survey responses were submitted.
columnDescriptions.month: Year-month period grouping the survey data.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Name of the hospital branch where the doctor practices.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical department within the hospital for this record.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Full name of the doctor being evaluated by patients.
columnDescriptions.survey_count: Total number of patient surveys submitted for the doctor.
columnDescriptions.very_satisfied_count: Number of respondents who chose the highest satisfaction rating.
columnDescriptions.valid_answer_count: Number of surveys containing scoreable, valid responses.
columnDescriptions.very_satisfied_rate: Proportion of very satisfied responses among all valid answers.

tableDescription: Detailed patient satisfaction survey responses per question, linking hospital, department, doctor, and individual answers.

columnDescriptions.survey_id: Unique numeric identifier for each submitted patient satisfaction survey.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical department where the patient received care, e.g., obstetrics or pediatrics.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Name of the attending physician associated with the survey submission.
columnDescriptions.submit_date: Date the patient submitted the satisfaction survey.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Name of the hospital branch or campus where the visit occurred.
columnDescriptions.survey_name: Full title of the satisfaction survey form administered to the patient.
columnDescriptions.question_id: Unique code identifying the specific question within the survey.
columnDescriptions.question_text: Full wording of the survey question presented to the patient.
columnDescriptions.question_category: Numeric grouping that classifies the question within the survey structure.
columnDescriptions.question_type: Format type of the question, e.g., rating scale, open-ended, or other.
columnDescriptions.answer: Patient's response, including free-text feedback or selected option.
columnDescriptions.standard_hospital: Normalized hospital name used for consistent cross-branch reporting and analysis.

tableDescription: Detail view of patient satisfaction survey responses rated below "very satisfied" across hospital branches and departments.

columnDescriptions.survey_id: Unique numeric identifier for each patient survey submission.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical department where the patient received care.
columnDescriptions.doctor: Name of the attending physician associated with the survey.
columnDescriptions.submit_date: Date the patient submitted the satisfaction survey.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Hospital branch or campus where care was provided.
columnDescriptions.survey_name: Full title of the specific satisfaction questionnaire administered.
columnDescriptions.question_id: Short code uniquely identifying each question within a survey.
columnDescriptions.question_text: Full wording of the survey question presented to the patient.
columnDescriptions.question_category: Numeric code grouping questions into broader satisfaction categories.
columnDescriptions.question_type: Topic label classifying the service aspect being evaluated.
columnDescriptions.answer: Patient's selected response indicating their satisfaction level.
columnDescriptions.standard_hospital: Normalized hospital branch name for consistent cross-branch reporting.

tableDescription: Monthly Net Promoter Score metrics aggregated by hospital campus and clinical department, tracking patient satisfaction survey outcomes.

columnDescriptions.month: Survey reference month in YYYY-MM format; defines the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.hospital: Name of the hospital campus or branch where surveys were collected.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical department or specialty unit within the hospital.
columnDescriptions.nps_answer_count: Total number of valid patient NPS survey responses in the period.
columnDescriptions.promoter_count: Count of respondents scoring high enough to be classified as promoters.
columnDescriptions.detractor_count: Count of respondents scoring low enough to be classified as detractors.
columnDescriptions.nps: Decimal NPS score (0–1); higher values reflect stronger patient loyalty.

tableDescription: Monthly patient satisfaction survey recovery metrics segmented by hospital branch, department, and visit type.

columnDescriptions.hospital: Hospital campus or branch where the visits occurred.
columnDescriptions.department: Clinical or specialty department within the hospital.
columnDescriptions.visit_type: Classification of patient visit, such as outpatient or inpatient.
columnDescriptions.survey_count: Number of patient satisfaction surveys successfully collected in the period.
columnDescriptions.visit_count: Total patient visits in the period; serves as the survey denominator.
columnDescriptions.recovery_rate: Share of visits that yielded a completed survey; survey capture ratio.
